title: Unwarranted
summary: UNWAR'RANTED, adjective 1. Not warranted; not authorized. 2. Not ascertained; not assured or certain. 3. Not covenanted to be good, sound, or of a certain quality; as an unwarranted horse.

inlines.v: UNWAR'RANTED, adjective 1. Not warranted; not authorized. 2. Not ascertained; not assured or certain. 3. Not covenanted to be good, sound, or of a certain quality; as an unwarranted horse.
